content.value: In an air standard diesel cycle, the compression ratio is 16 and at the beginning of isentropic compression the temperature is 15°C and the pressure is 0.1 MPa. Heat is added until the temperature at the end of the constant pressure process is 1480°C. Calculate i) the cut-off ratio, ii) heat supplied per kg of air, iii) the cycle efficiency and iv) the mean effective pressure.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
